caption: Archers shoot down the front mounts of a cavalry squadron that holds its ground. Each fallen mount's file steps forward a rank to close the gap and the rear rank fills in behind, so the squadron keeps its seven files on its own centre line. Before this fix every mount behind a fallen one moved up one place in roster order, so mounts were sent across the squadron to the far end of the rank ahead; the squadron slid 3 m to one side and broke into uneven clumps.
